summary: Pumpkin Studios' Warzone 2100 began as a 1999 3D RTS and now survives through an actively maintained free/open-source project.

entries.title: Warzone 2100
entries.definitive_edition: Official Warzone 2100 Project current build from wz2100.net

emulation.notes: Native current builds are preferred; original retail capture may require legacy Windows or compatibility work.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official open-source build with exact version and content/video state documented

primary.why: The modern open-source Warzone 2100 Project build is the current maintained route, with cross-platform multiplayer, modern OS support, campaign videos, lobby updates, and source availability. The original retail PC/PlayStation versions remain historically important because balance, renderer, and campaign behavior have changed.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official wz2100.net build. Record version, OS, renderer, campaign/skirmish/multiplayer mode, videos installed, lobby/server state, mods/maps, balance mode, resolution, and whether the original 1999 retail route was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Launch-era balance, renderer, and campaign behavior
secondary.why: The open-source version is current and practical but has years of community changes.
PC/open-source route is the strategic fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Avoid unofficial Steam/package builds unless their provenance/version is documented; use the official project download when possible.
